items.title: Outreachy December 2026 to March 2027 Internships
items.text:
Host: Outreachy
Location: Remote
Deadline: Aug. 31, 2026 at 4pm UTC (initial application)

Initial applications are closed

The deadline to create an initial application has passed for the December 2026 Outreachy internship cohort. We are no longer accepting initial applications for internships. We encourage you to sign up for the announcements mailing list to get an email when the next round opens.

Timeline

Initial applications open: Aug. 24, 2026 at 4pm UTC
Project list finalized: Oct. 2, 2026
Initial application results available: Oct. 12, 2026 at 4pm UTC
Contribute to projects: Oct. 12, 2026 to Nov. 9, 2026
Final application, for applicants whose initial application was approved: Nov. 9, 2026 at 4pm UTC
Accepted interns announced: Nov. 30, 2026 at 4pm UTC
Internships period: Dec. 7, 2026 to March 8, 2027

Internship projects are offered in these areas:
- Git - 6 projects
- C programming - 4 projects
- Rust - 3 projects
- Python - 3 projects
- Shell scripting - 3 projects
- humanities-style text-based research, coding, Android app development, Android, Kotlin, Markdown, Documentation, Cybersecurity Fundamentals, C++, Type systems, Consensus building, API design, Linux, Kotlin development, Functional Programming
